name: Ancient and Primeval Beech Forests of the Carpathians and Other Regions of Europe
countries: North Macedonia, Spain, Italy, France, Poland, Albania, Austria, Belgium, Croatia, Romania, Ukraine, Bulgaria, Slovenia, Slovakia, Switzerland, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Germany, Czechia
description: This sprawling network of 93 forest patches stretches across 18 European countries, from Spain and Italy to Ukraine and Germany. Each protects stands of European beech, some of them virtually untouched since the last Ice Age. Walking beneath the tall, smooth-trunked trees, you see how beech spread from a few refuges across the continent, a process that still continues today.
